notes.title: Spaced practice
notes.text:
Lesson 1: Spaced practice
Review a little, often, instead of all at once.
Short sessions spread over days beat one long session.
notes.refined:
GOAL: Review a little, often, instead of all at once.

Short sessions spread over days beat one long session.

notes.title: Active recall
notes.text:
Lesson 2: Active recall
Test yourself before rereading.
Close the notes and write what you remember, then check.
notes.refined:
GOAL: Test yourself before rereading.

Close the notes and write what you remember, then check.

notes.title: Teach it back
notes.text:
Lesson 3: Teach it back
Explain it in plain words to someone else.
If you can't explain it simply, find the gap and fill it.
